title: The Little Lion's Roar | Manipuri Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A little lion roars so loud that the birds fly away, but he learns that a soft, gentle roar can help a friend in need.
Kind hearts are the strongest of all.
All the animals come to play with the kind little lion.
